stories.title: Yankees don't expect Judge (calf) to play in Wild Card series
stories.summary: Aaron Judge is not expected to be available for the Yankees' wild-card series as he continues to recover from a calf strain.

stories.title: Giants avoid 'devastating outcome' as QB Dart believed to have sprained MCL
stories.summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is believed to have sustained a sprained MCL on Monday night based on initial exams, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo. He will undergo an MRI on Tuesday.

stories.title: Red Sox commit to Tracy as long-term manager, keep Breslow through 2030
stories.summary: The Red Sox signed Chad Tracy to a three-year contract as manager while also exercising the 2029 and 2030 options on chief baseball officer Craig Breslow.
